permAcceptEditsHint: Edits files without asking; risky commands are declined since nobody is around to approve them
permDefaultHint: Nobody is around to approve anything in the background, so everything risky (edits, commands) is declined. Good for read-only tasks
permBypassHint: Any files, commands and internet access without limits. Only for tasks you trust
title: Schedule
intro: Claude runs tasks on its own on a schedule while Claude Desk is open. Each run is saved as a regular chat, and the result arrives as a Windows or Telegram notification. A missed daily run happens the next time the app opens.
emptyExample: For example: "every morning, check dependencies and open TODOs and send me a summary".
deleteMessage: "{name}" will no longer run. Chats from past runs will be kept.
name: Name
promptPlaceholder: Check new commits on main, run the tests and briefly describe what broke
setupBotFirst: set up the bot below first
tgHowto1: Create a bot with {link} using /newbot and copy the token.
tgHowto2: Send your bot any message (e.g. /start), otherwise it can't reply to you.
tgHowto3: Get your chat id from {link} and paste it below.
tokenSavedPlaceholder: Token saved. Enter a new one to replace it
removeTokenMessage: Telegram notifications will stop and Telegram remote control will be turned off.
